title: Implementation claim — structural placeholder
description: Bounded claim to embody a constitutional function or capability; no embodiment is privileged and no claim is certified here.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

claimant.description: Attributable bearer of the claim, not a self-appointed constitutional authority.

bearer_or_mechanism.description: Exact embodiment to which the claim applies.

constitutional_reference.description: Exact source provisions and the function or capability claimed.

locality.description: Exact Locality of the supported claim; no general applicability inferred.

scope.description: Bounded function, act, or capability claimed.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the claimed capability or function is supported.

demonstration.description: Evidence with declared object, method, scope, time, basis, result, and effect ceiling.

dependencies.description: Material dependencies, interruption risks, replacement posture, and consequences of loss.

failure_boundaries.description: Known limits, uncertainty, and unsupported cases.

present_status.description: Present qualification at the stated scope, not presumed from publication or historical success.

effect_ceiling.description: No Source, Authority, Agency, autonomy, adoption, or constitutional effect created by the claim, conformance, custody, or successful operation.
